p: Nathan unto David: Because David lay now drowned in sin, the loving mercy of God which does not allow his own to perish, wakes his conscience by this story and brings him to repentance.
house: For David succeeded Saul in his kingdom.
wives into thy bosom: The Jews take this to be Eglah and Michal, or Rizpah and Michal.
such and such things: That is, greater things than these: for God's love and benefits increase toward his own, if they do not hinder him by their ingratitude.
children of Ammon: You have most cruelly given him into the hands of God's enemies.
put away thy sin: For the Lord seeks the sinner to turn to him.
blaspheme: In saying, that the Lord has appointed a wicked man to reign over his people.
went in: That is, to his private chamber.
bread with them: Thinking by his constant prayer that God would have restored his child, but God had determined otherwise.
arose from the earth: Showing that our lamentations should not be excessive, but moderate: and that we must praise God in all his doings.
said his servants unto him: As they who did not consider that God grants many things to the sobs and tears of the faithful.
can I bring him back again: By this consideration he appeased his sorrow.
he called his name Solomon: That is, the Lord, 1Ch 22:9.
he called his name Jedidiah: Meaning, David.
waters: That is, the chief city and where all the water pipes are, is as good as taken.
talent of gold with the precious: That is, 60 pounds after the weight of the common talent.
saws: Signifying that as they were malicious enemies of God, so he put them to cruel death.
